assumptions: stated for a MODEL of the runner; the real runner's observer model is undeclared (NEW-27A-OBSERVER)
the reduction is a verification route, not an ontological conclusion — see TAX-FLOW
attrs.evidence: Non-interference for observer O under policy Π: for all H, H′ and all low inputs ℓ with Π(ℓ) = withhold, view_O(run(H; ℓ)) = view_O(run(H′; ℓ)). This is a hyperproperty in the Clarkson–Schneider sense and 2-safety specifically; Barthe–D'Argenio–Rezk self-composition turns it into a safety property of run × run on (H, H′, ℓ). Recorded on cells 27a and 34 as `relational_arity: 2` metadata rather than as a ninth kind.
attrs.prior_art: Clarkson & Schneider, Hyperproperties, JCS 2010 · Barthe, D'Argenio, Rezk, Secure Information Flow by Self-Composition, CSFW 2004.
attrs.review_focus: The executable two-run object exists only against a MODEL of the frozen runner. Building it against the real runner, with a declared observer model covering timing and resource-usage channels, is the work that would discharge this for 27a.
attrs.statement: The strong reading of cell 27a is a 2-safety property: its refutation is a PAIR of low-equivalent runs, relative to a declared observer model and declassification policy, and self-composition reduces it to ordinary safety on the product system.
